sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract In this work, we present Qwen3, the latest version of the Qwen model family. Qwen3 comprises a series of large language models (LLMs) designed to advance performance, efficiency, and multilingual capabilities. sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-2B is a miniature dense Qwen3.5 model — the full gated delta networks architecture, vision encoder, and 262K context, in a form small enough for 8 GB consumer GPUs or edge inference.
